choice_providers.label: Focused Performance
choice_providers.description: Choose the single Perform category that receives and may use the archetype's Extra Performance benefits.

fixed_options.name: Act
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (act).

fixed_options.name: Comedy
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (comedy).

fixed_options.name: Dance
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (dance).

fixed_options.name: Keyboard Instruments
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (keyboard instruments).

fixed_options.name: Oratory
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (oratory).

fixed_options.name: Percussion Instruments
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (percussion instruments).

fixed_options.name: Sing
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (sing).

fixed_options.name: String Instruments
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (string instruments).

fixed_options.name: Wind Instruments
fixed_options.description: Extra Performance rounds apply only to Perform (wind instruments).

resource_adjustments.description: Base Bardic Performance rounds plus 6 focused rounds at 2nd level and another 6 at 8th, 14th, and 20th. The bonus rounds may be used only with the chosen Focused Performance category.

resources.name: Busker Stunt
resources.description: Rounds per day equal 4 + Charisma modifier. Select and maintain one retained stunt at a time.

resources.name: Passion
resources.description: A fluctuating pool equal to 1 + practitioner modifier (minimum 1). Spend it on retained Passion abilities; restore it after one minute of rest or through the feature's natural-roll and martial-focus triggers.

choice_providers.label: Musician's Muse
choice_providers.description: Choose the permanent creative style and its associated Performance package.

fixed_options.name: Improvisation
fixed_options.description: Associated package: any. Grants Segue and the Improvisation muse progression.

fixed_options.name: Intensity
fixed_options.description: Associated package: any. Grants Passionate Heart and the Intensity muse progression.

fixed_options.name: Harmony
fixed_options.description: Associated package: Instrumental or Lyric. Grants Rouser of Spirits and the Harmony muse progression.

fixed_options.name: Grandeur
fixed_options.description: Associated package: Act or Dance. Grants Broad Appeal and the Grandeur muse progression.

resources.name: Bonded Weapon Spell
resources.description: Once per day, cast one additional known spell through the selected bonded weapon.

resources.name: Bonded Object Spell
resources.description: Once per day, cast one additional known spell through the selected non-weapon bonded object.

power_providers.label: Negotiator Rogue Talents
power_providers.description: Choose a Rogue talent at 2nd level and every 4 levels thereafter. Advanced talents unlock at 10th level. Talents that modify Sneak Attack are unavailable.

resources.name: Archaeologist's Luck
resources.description: Rounds per day equal 4 + Charisma modifier. While active, its luck bonus applies to attacks, weapon damage, saves, and skills and scales at levels 5, 11, and 17.

power_providers.label: Rogue Talents
power_providers.description: Choose one Rogue talent at 4th level and every 4 Bard levels thereafter; advanced talents become available from 12th level.

power_providers.label: Hoaxer Hexes
power_providers.description: Choose from the Hoaxer's restricted hex list. Major options unlock at 12th level.

power_providers.label: Ki Powers
power_providers.description: Choose one Unchained Monk ki power at 4th level and every 2 levels thereafter. Spell points pay ki costs one-for-one.

resources.name: Famous Region
resources.description: Record the current settlement or region in which Famous applies. Its population limit and Diplomacy/Intimidate bonus scale at Bard levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17.

resources.name: Famous Region
resources.description: Record the current settlement or region in which Famous applies. Its population limit and Bluff/Intimidate bonus scale at Bard levels 1, 5, 9, 13, and 17.

choice_providers.label: Nature Magic (1st)
choice_providers.description: Choose the 1st-level Druid or Ranger spell learned as a Bard spell known at level 1.

choice_providers.label: Nature Magic (4th)
choice_providers.description: Choose a Druid or Ranger spell of a level the Bard can cast at level 4.

choice_providers.label: Nature Magic (7th)
choice_providers.description: Choose a Druid or Ranger spell of a level the Bard can cast at level 7.

choice_providers.label: Nature Magic (10th)
choice_providers.description: Choose a Druid or Ranger spell of a level the Bard can cast at level 10.

choice_providers.label: Nature Magic (13th)
choice_providers.description: Choose a Druid or Ranger spell of a level the Bard can cast at level 13.

choice_providers.label: Nature Magic (16th)
choice_providers.description: Choose a Druid or Ranger spell of a level the Bard can cast at level 16.

entries.choice_handling_note: The required Beastmastery (handle animal) package is fixed by the archetype rather than selected from multiple legal options.
Inspire or discourage is chosen separately for each target when the emotion effect is used; it is not a persistent character-build choice.
